title: Produce repeatable package timestamps
goal: Freeze NuGet archive timestamps across repeated builds by opting into a fixed pack timestamp, while checking the other inputs needed for reproducibility.

selectionNotes: Use a fixed timestamp for repeated builds; true alone uses the current build time.
Timestamp reproducibility does not guarantee arbitrary package or signed-artifact reproducibility.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Runtime of the selected SDK build/package tooling; this route is catalogued for target 11.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: The documented .NET 11 SDK/MSBuild/NuGet command behavior; exact RC2 verification is recorded separately.

language.name: C#
language.reason: C# mode of the compiled verification utility and older normalization helper; the newer MSBuild properties require no language feature.

platforms: Platforms supported by the declared .NET SDK/runtime; actual sample execution was Windows x64 only.
prerequisites: Inspect effective SDK, target framework, shared build/package files, imports and package source policy before applying this recipe.
constraints: Use a fixed timestamp for repeated builds; true alone uses the current build time.
Timestamp reproducibility does not guarantee arbitrary package or signed-artifact reproducibility.
optIns: Deterministic=true with a fixed DeterministicTimestamp, e.g. 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z.
stabilityLimitations: Verified with SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105 (RC2), not GA. No publisher-designated experimental API; GA reconciliation remains separate.

sources.title: NuGet RC1 timestamp opt-in and client asset migration
Pinned PackageBuilder timestamp parsing and behavior
Pack timestamp default and removed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH fallback

evidence.scope: Actual Windows x64 compilation and .NET 10 SDK local packing with isolated feed/cache/home; repeated unsigned ZIP entry normalization to a fixed date. No claim that .NET 10 honors DeterministicTimestamp, and no signing or general byte reproducibility proof.

Actual Windows x64 compilation and RC2 SDK local packing with isolated feed/cache/home: fixed RFC3339/Unix timestamp repeatability, bounded equal package bytes, true build time and default/false payload modification times. Not signing, general whole-build reproducibility or GA proof.

humanProof.scope: Local SDK packing and managed archive reading require no provider, account, workload, native UI or external resource. Actual behavior was executed on Windows x64.
